answer: Each identity is admitted only after a Wesolowski VDF completes a prescribed chain of modular squarings, with each result depending on the previous one. GPUs can run separate clone chains concurrently, but cannot shorten an individual chain through within-chain parallelism; every additional identity therefore requires its own sequential work and time. From dawn across the dune to each vertex of the network, this limits how quickly an attacker can create identities.
